name: log-viewer
title: Log viewer
description: Terminal-style log pane: coloured levels with counts as filters, search with marked matches, and a Follow switch that tracks new lines.
htmlExample: <bef-log-viewer class="w-[44rem] max-w-full" :lines='[{"time":"10:42:01","level":"info","source":"api","message":"Server listening on :8080"},{"time":"10:42:03","level":"debug","source":"db","message":"Pool opened with 10 connections"},{"time":"10:42:09","level":"info","source":"api","message":"GET /orders 200 42ms"},{"time":"10:42:11","level":"warn","source":"cache","message":"Redis latency 310ms, above the 200ms budget"},{"time":"10:42:14","level":"info","source":"api","message":"POST /orders 201 118ms"},{"time":"10:42:20","level":"error","source":"payments","message":"Charge failed for order 4471: card_declined"},{"time":"10:42:20","level":"warn","source":"payments","message":"Retrying charge in 30s (attempt 2 of 3)"},{"time":"10:42:31","level":"info","source":"api","message":"GET /orders/4471 200 31ms"},{"time":"10:42:50","level":"debug","source":"queue","message":"Worker picked job email.receipt"},{"time":"10:42:51","level":"error","source":"mailer","message":"SMTP timeout after 5000ms"},{"time":"10:43:02","level":"info","source":"api","message":"GET /health 200 2ms"}]' :height="260"></bef-log-viewer>
